method: Unannotated chronological contact sheets: every third factory frame; approximately one-second smoke samples plus 0.2-second onset and 0.5-second doorway sequences. Full source decode verified. Boundaries are coarse and uncertain windows excluded.
limitations: Single assistant reviewer; previous detector failure examples already known, not blinded independent validation
Visible plume appearance does not chemically verify combustion; no production-accuracy claim
notes: Plume visibly emerges around the far doorway and spreads upward/left. No distinct resolvable flame contour. Saturation, orange/yellow illumination and occlusion prevent reliable fire-present/absent judgment; fire excluded from scoring. Faint residual haze end is uncertain.
